summary: Spec fidelity: option_of_line opens a block only for '--name', '-l, --name' or '-l <V>, --name'. A short option with a bare metavariable ('-l N, --limit N', argparse's form) opens none, so L1.defaults silently skips that option's default (the old first --name anywhere reading judged it); and a short-only option line ('-n <N>  ... [default: 5]') is no option line, so it does not end the block of the option above it and its default can be read as that option's. Brief F1 names only '-l, ' so the code is inside the letter; scenario 87's Given lists '--limit=<N>' but the test uses --max=<N>. Blast radius: tools whose help is not clap-shaped lose L1.defaults coverage with no report line.
